thesis: ASO has run hard into a stretched, late-stage setup: RSI14 is 74 and price sits 11.8% above SMA20 with volume fading since the breakout, while the last close already exceeds the mean analyst target. Reward/risk of about 1.15 is thin for a regime that is risk-off with high confidence, where a pullback entry can fail and the stop (capped at 58.8) is far below the 64-66 entry zone. Leverage is meaningful and growth is only low-single-digit, so the cheap multiples reflect a modest business rather than a mispricing. News and SEC filings could not be fetched this run, so offering or event risk is unassessed; this is missing data and not a confirmed binary event. High short interest adds volatility in both directions, including sharp reversals once the squeeze fades.
